svg.title: Decision caution: where you set the threshold
svg.desc: Simulated evidence-accumulation trajectories and response-time histograms for narrow and wide decision bounds, where the reason for including it is that a higher threshold trades speed for accuracy with identical evidence.
svg.text: Decision caution: where you set the threshold
Same evidence quality in both. Only the threshold moved. Neither is the right one.
Simulated. Same drift, bounds 1.0 and 2.2. Model: Ratcliff et al. 2016.
